title: Artemis III Won't Land on the Moon
description: NASA redefined Artemis III as a low Earth orbit test of rendezvous and docking between Orion and test landers from Blue Origin and SpaceX, planned for 2027, ahead of landings targeted for 2028.

beats.text: Artemis III won't touch the Moon
beats.vo: The next Artemis flight will not land on the Moon. It is a docking rehearsal.

beats.text: Three spacecraft, two weeks, Earth orbit
points: Orion docks with Blue Moon test lander
Then docks with Starship test article
beats.vo: Artemis three, planned for next year, keeps four astronauts in Earth orbit. Orion will dock with test versions of a Blue Origin lander and a SpaceX Starship. It proves the hardware before landings, which NASA is targeting for twenty twenty eight.
Follow for a daily dose of engineering.

caption:
Artemis III won't land on the Moon 🌙
NASA turned it into an Earth-orbit rehearsal: Orion docks with test landers from Blue Origin and SpaceX (launch planned 2027). Landings are targeted for 2028. Test articles aren't flight-ready landers, and dates can slip.
